run_gen_build_yaml: run the script to generate a YAML build configuration for boringssl from sources.json
create_Grpc_adapter: create a Grpc adapter instance from a sources dictionary to build boringssl YAML config
call_WriteFiles: call WriteFiles on a Grpc instance with a files dict to populate the yaml build structure
use_map_dir: use map_dir to prepend the boringssl-with-bazel path prefix to a source filename
summarize_Grpc_class: summarize the Grpc class which adapts boringssl JSON sources into a gRPC build YAML structure
